The '''Iridium Fireplace''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased from the [[Night Market#Magic Shop Boat|Magic Shop Boat]] on any day of the [[Night Market]] for {{Price|15000}}.  

[[Furniture#Fireplaces|Fireplaces]] cannot be placed outside. Once placed, right-clicking on it will turn the fire on or off.

==History==
